note: RV park on Sturgis Road in Piedmont beside I-90, between Rapid City and Sturgis. Back-in and pull-through sites (picnic tables at some), two boondock sites, electric tent sites on covered concrete pads, and rustic and full cabins; heated pool in summer; Bar 46 & Casino on site. No wood campfires. --Claude
